sloka: एषा सा दृश्यते सीते सरयूर्यूपमालिनी ।नानातरुशताकीर्णा सम्प्रपुष्पितकानना ।। ६.१२६.५१ ।।
transliteration: eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte sarayūryūpamālinī ।nānātaruśatākīrṇā samprapuṣpitakānanā ।। 6.126.51 ।।

translations.english: "See the glowing hermitage of the great sage Sutikshna. Vaidehi, see Sarabhanga's hermitage here, where the thousand eyed Indra, the destroyer of citadels (Purandara) had come."
